Astrology is a science, not some form of mystical superstition, and it is clearly not mastered here.

The session consisted mainly of alarming and negative predictions, followed by the proposal of so-called “one and only” miracle solutions.
Astrology is meant to guide people in life and help them understand themselves better in order to make wiser choices — not to instill fear.

It is deeply disrespectful to see pseudo-gurus like this, who clearly lack real astrological knowledge, claim to be astrologers. Sadly, some people may fall into this trap and end up buying everything just to “protect themselves” from supposed bad luck or bad planets.

I stayed until the end of the session and repeatedly asked specific astrological questions (for example about houses and planetary positions). None of them were answered properly; the responses were always completely off topic.

The guru clearly lacks genuine astrological expertise and seems to rely on fear as a strategy to push clients into purchasing talismans and additional services.

None of the predictions were accurate. In fact, if I had not spoken myself about my personal life, nothing relevant would have been predicted at all.

I respect everyone’s beliefs, but if you are looking for a real astrologer, please choose someone truly competent and knowledgeable in the field.
Be very careful and do not fall into this .
